content.title: Licensing Tutorials
content.summary: The City of Arvada utilizes MUNIRevs for online tax reporting, payments, and business licensing. An informative video is available to guide users through the registration process for new businesses.
content.body:
## How to Register with MUNIRevs

The City of Arvada uses MUNIRevs for online tax reporting and payments as well as online business licensing. Review our informative video that will quickly and easily walk you through the registration process.
